accounts.label: mana-modal
accounts.usage_unavailable: the GPU usage ledger aggregates every provider's records for a window and has no per-account filter, so this account's share of the totals cannot be attributed

sizing.kv_bytes_per_token_basis: full_attention_layers=16 of 64 (hybrid linear attention; the other 48 hold a fixed-size recurrent state and no per-token KV) x num_kv_heads=4 x head_dim=256 x dtype_bytes=1; x2 for K and V
assumptions: overhead_bytes 8589934592 (8 GiB) for activations, CUDA-graph capture, block padding and the fixed linear-attention state, excluding weights; vLLM documents no separate figure, so this default is calibrated rather than physical
--block-size 64; the pool is not rounded to whole blocks here because vLLM's reported figure already absorbs block padding
max_model_len is the per-session context used for the session count
the candidate architecture is rejected if it implies a negative overhead

only full_attention layers are counted: 16 of 64 layer_types entries hold a per-token KV cache, and the other 48 hold a fixed-size recurrent state. Counting all 64 layers would overestimate the KV cache 4x
warnings: No measurement of this model on this card is recorded, so there is no delta to check the estimate against. vLLM's own startup line reports the authoritative KV size.

notes: credentials are reported as vault fingerprints, never as values
`plan` is what the operator declared; it is never inferred from the card's free-plan state, which is often `unknown`
